Name: Zerah, Son of Adaiah
Summary: Son of Adaiah and father of Ethni in Asaph's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:41: Son of Adaiah and father of Ethni in Asaph's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zerah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
